correctness.rationale: For D_(6,3), an edge set has domination >=3 iff no pair of closed neighborhoods covers all six labeled vertices; direct enumeration of 2^15 edge masks gives exactly 4502 faces of dimensions 0..6, counts 15,105,455,1185,1647,915,180. Independently recomputed mod-two full boundary ranks 14,91,364,821,711,180 and separate exact integer unit-pivot elimination for differential degrees 5 and 6 (ranks711 and180, ker d5 dimension204). A freely normalized kernel basis gives all eleven signed conjugacy-class traces, verifying H4 dim115 and H5 dim24 and table; Specht inner products/character theory give asserted irreducible multiplicities with correct dimensions. This exhaustive finite argument covers the one stated graph only; no n-uniform inference.
